title: Indicate on the "Applications" tab when anything in it is set to less than 100%
line: The Audio Volume widget's Applications tab now shows the lowest app volume, like "Applications (35%)", whenever an app is turned down.
explanation: The Audio Volume popup opens on the Devices tab, and nothing there shows that an application's own volume was lowered. The reporter's Firefox was turned down without them knowing, so they kept raising the device volume instead. The Applications tab label now includes the lowest volume among playback streams when one is below 100% (a muted stream counts as 0%), and goes back to plain "Applications" when all are at 100% or more.

commits.message:
applet: show the lowest application volume on the Applications tab

When an application had been turned down, nothing on the Devices tab
hinted at it, so users kept raising the device volume instead. Now the
Applications tab shows the lowest playback volume when it's below 100%.

BUG: 516642

The tab now reads "Applications (35%)" from the Devices tab
